hooks.prompt: Read $ARGUMENTS to get tool_input.file_path. If the path starts with 'src/' or 'backend/', act as the docs-compliance agent: (1) read every file in docs/ — ui.md, auth.md, data-fetching.md, data-mutations.md, routing.md, server-components.md — and internalize every rule; (2) scan the edited file for violations; (3) fix every violation in place. Report FIXED <file>:<line> — <description> for each fix, or PASS if the file is clean. If the file is not under src/ or backend/, output nothing and stop.

hooks.command: claude -p "Act as the readme-updater agent: read README.md and the codebase, identify gaps (missing features, outdated entries, incomplete sections), update README.md to close them, and report each change as ADDED/UPDATED/FIXED."
